summary:
The window title feature is implemented but not run: per your instructions I only read and edited files, so no tests, mypy or Black checks were executed.

Changes:
- rich/segment.py: added SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 as the last enum member; ControlCode now also admits Tuple[ControlType, str].
- rich/control.py: added the SET_WINDOW_TITLE formatting entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item tuple to Control.
- rich/console.py: added set_window_title beside show_cursor. It checks only is_terminal, adds the title control via self.control, and returns True or False, with the spec's docstring.
- rich/_windows_renderer.py: one new elif branch that calls term.set_title with the title text. The wrapper is unchanged.
- CHANGELOG.md: created an Unreleased "Added" section above "Fixed" with a bullet linking pull request 2200.
- Tests: test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skipped on win32), test_control.py (test_control_title), test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows only, mocked wrapper).

Open point: Console.control() skips output when TERM=dumb, but set_window_title still returns True in that case because it checks only is_terminal, as the spec requires. The title is then silently not written. Decide whether that should return False.

Nothing was committed.
